title: array-equality-narrowing (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: Strict equality of two string lists is reachable, including empty lists, and preserves the string element contract.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago agrees with the scoped expectation. The source is not runnable PHP: array<int,string> is not native parameter syntax. The re-derivation uses standard PHPDoc with native array. Its historical claim that differently typed arrays can never be identical is also false because empty arrays intersect. Runtime explicitly covers empty equality.
